paragraphs: Caliper Corporation sells desktop software for mapping, geographic information systems, and transportation analysis. The Maptitude family covers business and data mapping, letting organizations put their own records on a map and study markets. A separate edition, Maptitude for Redistricting, is sold for drawing electoral districts, and the company calls it the preferred choice of state legislatures, political parties, and public interest groups.

On the transportation side, TransCAD is the travel demand modeling package. TransModeler SE is offered for traffic impact work. The Maptitude solutions index groups uses by industry, including a section devoted to GIS for local government. Listed political applications include municipal redistricting software.

Caliper says that for more than 40 years it has supplied software, data analytics, and consulting to businesses and government agencies. It states that its redistricting clients include a majority of the state legislatures, both political parties, and county and regional governments. Many metropolitan planning organizations, planning agencies, and consultants are described as relying on the company's products.
